issue.title: Bug: [Trixie] pyangbind==0.8.2 incompatibility with Debian 13 python 3.13

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

We install pyangbind==0.8.2 which has incompatibility with Debian 13 python 3.13 and needs to be updated.

https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/blob/5844ab7e2ba0dff6d9a85c3f35d13c0e1b0ea9fd/files/build_templates/sonic_debian_extension.j2#L205

```
# For sonic-config-engine Python 3 package
# Install pyangbind here, outside sonic-config-engine dependencies, as pyangbind causes enum34 to be installed.
# Then immediately uninstall enum34, as enum34 should not be installed for Python >= 3.4, as it causes a
# conflict with the new 'enum' module in the standard library
# https://github.com/robshakir/pyangbind/issues/232
sudo https_proxy=$https_proxy LANG=C chroot $FILESYSTEM_ROOT pip3 install pyangbind==0.8.2
sudo https_proxy=$https_proxy LANG=C chroot $FILESYSTEM_ROOT pip3 uninstall -y enum34

```
Please see the warnings below. This can be fixed by converting these strings to raw python strings r"". We need an appropriate pyangbind version that has this.

### Steps to Reproduce

`show acl table` will produce

```
/usr/local/lib/python3.13/dist-packages/pyangbind/lib/yangtypes.py:185: SyntaxWarning: invalid escape sequence '\g'
  current_restricted_class_type = regex.sub("<(type|class) '(?P<class>.*)'>", "\g<class>", six.text_type(base_type))
/usr/local/lib/python3.13/dist-packages/pyangbind/lib/yangtypes.py:227: SyntaxWarning: invalid escape sequence '\-'
  range_regex = regex.compile("(?P<low>\-?[0-9\.]+|min)([ ]+)?\.\.([ ]+)?" + "(?P<high>(\-?[0-9\.]+|max))")
/usr/local/lib/python3.13/dist-packages/pyangbind/lib/yangtypes.py:227: SyntaxWarning: invalid escape sequence '\-'
  range_regex = regex.compile("(?P<low>\-?[0-9\.]+|min)([ ]+)?\.\.([ ]+)?" + "(?P<high>(\-?[0-9\.]+|max))")
/usr/local/lib/python3.13/dist-packages/pyangbind/lib/yangtypes.py:228: SyntaxWarning: invalid escape sequence '\-'
  range_single_value_regex = regex.compile("(?P<value>\-?[0-9\.]+)")
/usr/local/lib/python3.13/dist-packages/pyangbind/lib/yangtypes.py:241: SyntaxWarning: invalid escape sequence '\$'
  tmp_pattern = tmp_pattern.replace("$", "\$")
/usr/local/lib/python3.13/dist-packages/pyangbind/lib/yangtypes.py:255: SyntaxWarning: invalid escape sequence '\g'
  low, high = range_regex.sub("\g<low>,\g<high>", range_spec).split(",")
/usr/local/lib/python3.13/dist-packages/pyangbind/lib/yangtypes.py:264: SyntaxWarning: invalid escape sequence '\g'
  eqval = range_single_value_regex.sub("\g<value>", range_spec)
/usr/local/lib/python3.13/dist-packages/pyangbind/lib/yangtypes.py:1030: SyntaxWarning: invalid escape sequence '\g'
  _pybind_base_class = regex.sub("<(type|class) '(?P<class>.*)'>", "\g<class>", str(base_type))
/usr/local/lib/python3.13/dist-packages/pyangbind/lib/yangtypes.py:1296: SyntaxWarning: invalid escape sequence '\g'
  self._type = regex.sub("<(type|class) '(?P<class>.*)'>", "\g<class>", str(get_method()._base_type))
Name                   Type    Binding      Description            Stage    Status
---------------------  ------  -----------  ---------------------  -------  --------
DATA_EGRESS_L3TEST     L3      Ethernet124  DATA_EGRESS_L3TEST     egress   Active
DATA_EGRESS_L3V6TEST   L3V6    Ethernet124  DATA_EGRESS_L3V6TEST   egress   Active
DATA_INGRESS_L3TEST    L3      Ethernet124  DATA_INGRESS_L3TEST    ingress  Active
DATA_INGRESS_L3V6TEST  L3V6    Ethernet124  DATA_INGRESS_L3V6TEST  ingress  Active

```

Before this be sure to configure acl with

```
   15  sudo config acl add table DATA_INGRESS_L3TEST L3 --description= --stage=ingress --ports=Ethernet124
   17  sudo config acl add table DATA_EGRESS_L3TEST L3 --description= --stage=egress --ports=Ethernet124
   19  sudo config acl add table DATA_INGRESS_L3V6TEST L3V6 --description= --stage=ingress --ports=Ethernet124
   21  sudo config acl add table DATA_EGRESS_L3V6TEST L3V6 --description= --stage=egress --ports=Ethernet124
sonic-cfggen -j acl_rules_DATA_EGRESS_L3V6TEST.json --write-to-db
```

the line 185 in /usr/local/lib/python3.13/dist-packages/pyangbind/lib/yangtypes.py is

```
 current_restricted_class_type = regex.sub("<(type|class) '(?P<class>.*)'>", "\g<class>", six.text_type(base_type))
```
This needs to be
```
 current_restricted_class_type = regex.sub(r"<(type|class) '(?P<class>.*)'>", r"\g<class>", six.text_type(base_type))
```

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Expected behavior: No warnings should be seen.
Actual behavior: We see python3.13 warnings

resolution.title: Upgrade pyangbind to avoid SyntaxWarning
resolution.description:
